phases.job: Build P1, S1 and the scientific foundations correctly. Speed here buys nothing later.

phases.job: Finish most AS teaching. P2 first, then FP1 and M1 once the P2 gate clears.

phases.name: AS completion
phases.job: Close syllabus gaps and run the first real diagnostics. Acceleration is licensed here or not at all.

phases.name: AS consolidation
phases.job: Stop almost all acceleration. Convert what you know into marks.

phases.name: Exam preparation
phases.job: Timed papers, practical work, error repair. Volume rises only if analysis holds.

phases.name: AS examinations
phases.job: Target the next paper. Nothing else earns a mark now.

phases.name: Post-AS acceleration
phases.job: FP2 and FP3 open immediately — the two hardest modules, started at the beginning of the year rather than after Christmas. A large A2 Chemistry and Physics push runs alongside.

phases.name: Full-course completion
phases.job: S3, then D1 last as the Overview asks, plus A2 science consolidation. Only four new Mathematics modules this year — P1 to P4 and S2 were finished in Year 1. The learning phase ends here, if the gates pass.

phases.name: A2 consolidation
phases.job: Eleven papers to convert. Four rotation rounds across the seven Edexcel units, plus Paper 4 cycles and a protected Paper 5 track.

phases.name: Final examinations
phases.job: Sit them. Release each finished unit and protect recovery between papers.

phases.name: Results and next steps
phases.job: Decompress, then applications and results day.

stages.name: Topic questions
stages.note: While first learning each topic. Notes open is fine here and nowhere else.

stages.name: Mixed-topic sets
stages.note: From November 2026. Strip the topic labels before you start.

stages.name: Exam conditions
stages.note: Late March onwards. No notes, no pauses, no second attempts.
